notes: All prior IDs sourced directly from six LOTTO45–50 manifests; no duplicate new identity for existing BWVs.
Genre corrections: BWV11 oratorio, BWV118 mottetto, BWV36c secular, BWV198 funeral ode, BWV50 fragment.
Author correction: BWV189 Hoffmann author and Bach historical misattribution edge, never Bach compone.
Reuses are movement-specific or explicitly uncertain; no transitive unrestricted propagation.
BWV156 and BWV1056 share earlier lost source; Flaminio's direct direction not asserted.
BWV198-to-BWV232 Kyrie source claim held without independently supported assertion.
BWV82 versions from prior manifest are separate versions, not compositions.
Documentary BWVs outside these 51 are not newly certified works.

nodes.obbligato: flauto traverso / organico oggetto di concordanza
nodes.detail: La nomenclatura della voce diverge tra Bach-Cantatas, IMSLP e Flaminio: non imporre categoricamente soprano o contralto. La redazione del 1735 non è un'opera differente.
